name: Healer's Kit
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text: Ten uses. Utilize: expend one use to stabilize an Unconscious creature with 0 Hit Points without a Wisdom (Medicine) check.

authored_operations: Ten uses. Utilize: expend one use to stabilize an Unconscious creature with 0 Hit Points without a Wisdom (Medicine) check.

definition.name: Healer's Kit
definition.description: A leather pouch of bandages, salves, and splints with ten uses. Used to stabilize a dying creature without a Medicine check.

unsupported_behavior.requirement: Healer’s Kit spends one of ten uses to stabilize only an eligible Unconscious zero-HP creature. Retain partial seed; map uses and actual targets, no free reset on equip/reload.
